scenarios.name: root-rest
scenarios.description: The reference's empty query over its own fixture rows, row 0 selected

scenarios.name: root-hover
scenarios.description: Rest, then the pointer moves onto unselected row 1, which selects it

scenarios.name: root-selected
scenarios.description: Rest, then the selection keys move the selection to row 2, one step at a time

scenarios.name: root-pointer-keys
scenarios.description: The pointer selects row 1; Down moves the selection to row 2 with the pointer resting on row 1, which keeps its hover wash; moving again over row 1 selects it

scenarios.name: root-selected-hover
scenarios.description: Row 2 selected by the keys, then the pointer arrives on that selected row

scenarios.name: root-focus
scenarios.description: Typing 'clip' into the focused field filters to the one matching row; Escape returns to rest

scenarios.name: root-actions
scenarios.description: Down selects Clipboard History; the footer's Actions button opens its actions over the dimmed results; typing filters them to one, then to none; Escape closes the panel only

scenarios.name: actions-panel
scenarios.description: The Actions board: the query 'fig' with Figma selected and its actions open over the dimmed results

scenarios.name: root-unavailable
scenarios.description: A row that cannot run here, with its reason (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: root-long-content
scenarios.description: A long title and subtitle under the row's truncation (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: launcher-frame
scenarios.description: The launcher's frame at rest: the 760x518 panel, its inset edges and corners, and the header, list and footer boundaries

scenarios.name: launcher-frame-light
scenarios.description: The same frame in the derived light appearance, at the same dimensions (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: launcher-frame-narrow
scenarios.description: A narrow launcher: the keys select the last row, which the list scrolls into view above the footer (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: tile-sizes
scenarios.description: The icon tile at the row's, a pinned slot's and the Actions header's size, as an application and as a command (no reference counterpart side by side)

scenarios.name: keycap-windows
scenarios.description: The production key sequences for the reference's Windows chords, its accent Enter and a compact pinned hint, and rebound chords the reference never shows

scenarios.name: settings-shell
scenarios.description: The Settings board's shell: the titlebar, the sidebar's search and sections with Appearance selected, the page's heading block and columns; then the pointer over an unselected section, and over the selected one

scenarios.name: settings-shell-narrow
scenarios.description: The same shell at 760x520: the titlebar and sidebar keep their size and the page's columns collapse into one (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: appearance-page
scenarios.description: The Settings board's Appearance page: Material with Glass chosen and its note, the accent swatches, the blur and tint sliders, Density and the two toggles, beside the preview's stage and miniature launcher; then the pointer over Frost, whose label lightens (#98). The swatches, sliders, Frost, density and toggles are the board's, deferred in production (#100)

scenarios.name: appearance-solid
scenarios.description: A click on Solid: its segment takes the wash, its note replaces Glass's, the blur and tint sliders keep their values at the board's 40% disabled opacity, and the miniature takes the solid surface (#98)

scenarios.name: appearance-production
scenarios.description: Production's own Appearance page through its composition: Theme (System, Light, Dark) and Material (Glass, Solid) with their descriptions, beside the preview in the appearance in effect (no reference counterpart: the board shows no theme choice)

scenarios.name: appearance-light
scenarios.description: Production's Appearance page in the derived light palette: Light chosen, the preview light (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: appearance-override
scenarios.description: Production's Appearance page under the run's development overrides: the notice naming them, both fields' labels and choices at the disabled opacity (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: appearance-narrow
scenarios.description: Production's Appearance page at 760x520: the fields take the page's width and the preview wraps below them (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: empty-state
scenarios.description: The empty board: 'kubectx' matches nothing, so the notice heads the fallbacks, none selected — the board preselects the first, which Pane never does (#100) — until Down selects it; the board's store suggestions are fixture content

scenarios.name: calculator-card
scenarios.description: The calculator board: '72 in to cm' answered by the selected card, with the board's units, conversions and recent calculations as fixture content (Pane's calculator answers arithmetic only, #100)

scenarios.name: answer-plain
scenarios.description: A computed answer as production presents it: '6*7' and 42 on the card under 'Calculator', no captions or chips (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: answer-long
scenarios.description: A computed answer whose expression is too long for the authored 34px: the values step down to fit their columns (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: empty-no-fallbacks
scenarios.description: The notice with no fallback under it, as production shows it to a user who chose none (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: clipboard-rest
scenarios.description: The clipboard board at rest: its fixture clips under Pinned, Today and Yesterday, the code clip selected and previewed (#102)

scenarios.name: clipboard-previews
scenarios.description: A click selects a clip without copying it: the text, color, link and image previews in turn

scenarios.name: clipboard-keys
scenarios.description: Down moves the selection from the code clip; five more reach the last clip, which the list scrolls into view

scenarios.name: clipboard-filter
scenarios.description: A query no clip matches: no preview and nothing selected; Escape clears it; the Text tab keeps the text clips

scenarios.name: clipboard-production
scenarios.description: Production's own content: text records under Today, Yesterday and Older, the All and Text tabs, what is kept, Copy, Delete and Manage (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: clipboard-off
scenarios.description: No records with history off: the note saying so, Turn on, no preview and no primary action (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: clipboard-narrow
scenarios.description: The split view in the launcher's own 760x518: the list keeps its width, the preview takes the rest, the keys reach the last record (no reference counterpart)

scenarios.name: pinned-strip
scenarios.description: The pinned home: five sample pins under the Pinned label above a blank query's rows; a query hides the strip and clearing it restores it; the pointer over slot 2 takes the slot's hover wash

scenarios.name: pinned-partial
scenarios.description: A partly filled home: two pins, one whose target cannot run with its reason, and three empty slots (no reference counterpart)
